Notes: First Pioneer Jewish settlers date to 1888; mostly Lithuanian; named early residents incl. a hairdresser a photographer a hotelier a butcher and an auctioneer; no count
Germiston and Georgetown Hebrew Congregation founded 1903 (High Holiday services in Masonic Hall 1900-1902); no count
Jewish burial ground (Primrose cemetery) consecrated 11 August 1907; no count
Synagogue built 1930; organized community; no count
Community reached approximately 600 families by the mid-1960s; Estimate based on families (600x5); year 1965 is midpoint of 'mid-1960s'
Community dwindled and the shul doors finally closed in 2001 (Pioneers page says closure Dec 2000); community closed but no source states no Jews remain
